en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a complex of multi‑storey institutional buildings arranged around landscaped gardens with paths, shrubs and trees in the foreground. The architecture is early‑20th‑century German, with tiled gable roofs and plain facades. In the distance a towered building is visible. Printed German text along the bottom identifies the site as the Saxon State Police School in Meißen and specifically the officials' residence. A red handwritten number "25633" appears on the upper right.
